historical_references.reference: The term Tapeshwar first appeared in the 11th century CE inscriptions of the Katyuri kings of Kannauj. The Katyuri kings, who ruled over large parts of northern India, used the title to denote their allegiance to Shiva and to claim divine legitimacy for their rule.
